# Discover Lithuania

> A curated travel guide to Lithuania — 170 handpicked cafés, restaurants, stays, nature spots and ready-made routes across 10 regions. Available in English and Hebrew.

## About the site

Discover Lithuania is an independent travel guide built by Niv Shimoni — entrepreneur, AI builder, and someone who keeps ending up in Lithuania. Every place on the site has been personally reviewed or vetted. Not sponsored. Not algorithmic. Just what's actually worth visiting.

The site covers 170 places across 10 regions: Vilnius, Trakai, Kaunas, Klaipėda, the Curonian Spit (Nida), Druskininkai, Palanga, Molėtai, Zarasai, and the Lithuanian countryside.

## What you'll find

- **Places**: cafés, restaurants, nature spots, stays, cultural sites — each with a personal note from Niv on why it's worth visiting
- **Routes**: ready-made itineraries for every trip length — from a single day to a full weekend
- **Food guide**: traditional Lithuanian dishes explained (cepelinai, šaltibarščiai, kibinai, and more)
- **Stays**: handpicked accommodation from boutique spas to forest cabins and lake villas

## Ready-made itineraries

- **A Perfect Day in Vilnius** — Baroque alleys, Užupis art republic, MO Museum, rooftop drinks
- **Vilnius & The Region** (weekend) — Vilnius day + Trakai castle, Snapas café, hot air balloon over the lakes
- **A Weekend in the Forests** — forest cabins, lakes, traditional sauna (pirtis)
- **Three Days on the Coast** — Klaipėda old town, Curonian Spit dunes, Nida lagoon, Stebuklai SPA
- **Druskininkai Spa Weekend** — mineral springs, float therapy, pine forest walks

## Highlights

- Vilnius Old Town (UNESCO) — cobblestones, Baroque churches, best coffee scene in the Baltics
- Curonian Spit — UNESCO dunes, pine forests, and the idyllic village of Nida
- Trakai Castle — 14th-century island fortress on Lake Galvė, Karaim culture, kibinai pastries
- Druskininkai — mineral springs, spa retreats, Grūtas Soviet sculpture park
- Klaipėda — German-Prussian old town and Baltic port city
- Aukštaitija National Park — 3,000+ lakes, forest trails, canoe routes
- Snapas café, Trakai — cozy lakeside spot for coffee and pastry before the castle

Long-form guides and guest stories (each also available in Hebrew at the same URL + /he/):

- [5 Days in Lithuania Itinerary (2026) — Complete Travel Guide](https://lithuaniadiscovery.com/blog/5-days-in-lithuania): The perfect 5-day Lithuania itinerary: Vilnius Old Town, Trakai Island Castle, and the underrated Art Deco city of Kaunas. Real recommendations — updated.
- [From Pencil to Clay: Agnes BR's Creative Journey](https://lithuaniadiscovery.com/blog/agnes-br-ceramics): Meet Agnes BR, a Vilnius-based ceramics artist working from a manor studio in Trakų Vokė. Her journey from finance to hand-painted ceramics, in her own words.
- [6 Best Coffee Shops in Vilnius (2026) — Local Guide](https://lithuaniadiscovery.com/blog/best-coffee-vilnius): The best coffee shops in Vilnius, tested and curated — where locals actually drink coffee, what to order, and when to go.
- [9 Best Restaurants in Vilnius (2026), Local Picks](https://lithuaniadiscovery.com/blog/best-restaurants-vilnius): The 9 best restaurants in Vilnius for dinner, from Italian pasta to Michelin-starred Lithuanian cuisine. What to order, when to go, and whether to book.
- [Cepelinai: My Mum's Recipe, by Brigita Uyar](https://lithuaniadiscovery.com/blog/cepelinai-brigita-uyar): Guest post by Lithuanian food blogger Brigita Uyar: the story and recipe behind her mum's cepelinai, Lithuania's most beloved potato dumplings.
- [A-Frame Cabins in Lithuania](https://lithuaniadiscovery.com/blog/doyou-place): A quiet stay at DOYOU PLACE, A-frame cabins by a lake in Lithuania, an hour's drive from Vilnius. Silence, nature, and a place to slow down.
- [Natural Wine in Lithuania: Ieva Elvyra’s Story](https://lithuaniadiscovery.com/blog/ieva-elvyra-natural-wine): Ieva Elvyra, wine storyteller and former Revolut communications lead, tells how she left corporate life, fell for natural wine and found her voice in Lithuania.
- [BREW Bakery Vilnius: A Pastry Chef's Story](https://lithuaniadiscovery.com/blog/jekaterina-brew-bakery): Jekaterina Zvonkuviene, pastry chef at BREW Bakery in Vilnius, tells her story: from art books and mathematics to a cardamom bun that is unmistakably hers.
- [The Lost Shtetl Museum: Where a Vanished World Comes Back to Life](https://lithuaniadiscovery.com/blog/lost-shtetl-museum): The team of the Lost Shtetl Museum in Šeduva shares the story behind Lithuania's newest museum, introduced by Niv Shimoni: a vanished Jewish world brought back to life.
- [Trakai Day Trip from Vilnius (2026) — Complete Guide](https://lithuaniadiscovery.com/blog/trakai-day-trip): Everything you need for a perfect Trakai day trip from Vilnius — the castle, kibinai, boat rentals, hot air balloon rides and hidden gems. Full guide.
- [Žagarės Beigeliai: Bagels in Žagarė, Lithuania](https://lithuaniadiscovery.com/blog/zagares-beigeliai): Ernesta of Žagarės Beigeliai shares how she brought sourdough bagels to Žagarė, a small Lithuanian town with a deep Jewish history. Address, baking weekends and how to visit.

## Practical info

- **Currency**: Euro (€) — Lithuania is affordable. Coffee ~€3, full meal €8–15.
- **Language**: Lithuanian. English widely spoken in cities.
- **Best time to visit**: May–September. June–August is peak season with festivals and long days.
- **Getting there**: Vilnius Airport (VNO) has direct flights from Tel Aviv, London, Berlin, Warsaw, Riga.
- **Safety**: One of the safest countries in Europe. Low crime, especially in tourist areas.

## Who this is for

Travelers who want real recommendations — not TripAdvisor averages or Wikipedia entries. Particularly useful for Israeli travelers (site is bilingual Hebrew/English), first-time Lithuania visitors, and anyone planning a 3–7 day trip.
